title: BIGGEST COMPANIES
subtitle: MARKET CAP - 2000 to 2026
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: In the year two thousand, oil and software giants ruled the market. Then everything changed. Apple explodes from nearly nothing. Amazon and Google rise. And Nvidia, once tiny, storms to the very top in just a few years, powered by the chips behind artificial intelligence. By twenty twenty-six, the trillion dollar throne belongs to a whole new king. Which company takes it next? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
